partnershipPlan: Two volunteer responders and a member of the agency's youth advisory group review the outcome definitions and the acceptability scale; the volunteer coordinator shares monthly fidelity summaries at team meetings.
socialListening: A three-month read of public posts that mention the line by name, recorded as composites without usernames and without replying.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I sent the text and watched the screen for ten minutes; nothing, so I put the phone down.
items.implication: Measure abandonment by minute of wait, not only overall.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: It feels wrong to leave someone waiting because another message has a keyword, but I know why we do it.
items.implication: Include queue-order acceptability in the volunteer scale.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If I get the surge alert at midnight after a full day, I will log in, but not every night.
items.implication: Track counsellor overtime as a balancing measure.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The instant bot message helped; at least I knew someone would come.
items.implication: Report abandonment before and after the automated reply separately.

summary: Four composite voices on waiting, fairness, surge fatigue and automated replies.
